style.loanwords_text: Translate established Turkish technical terms such as cüzdan, blok and akıllı sözleşme. Keep entrenched loanwords and all entries explicitly marked keep English, including token, staking and faucet. Preserve protected names verbatim. Apply each reviewed concept consistently while allowing its approved grammatical/contextual variants.
writing_rules: Restrict first-use English glosses to translated specialist terms that benefit from disambiguation. Use parentheses, do not repeat the gloss, and never add English-English parentheses to a term already kept in English.
Never put an English gloss in nested square brackets inside a Markdown link label; preserve ordinary Markdown link syntax.
Preserve stylized product and code casing, including zcashd, zebrad and zk-SNARK, even at the start of a sentence.
Use a point to group thousands in Turkish prose (for example 1.234,5). Preserve code, hashes, version identifiers and protocol literals exactly; do not localize their numeric punctuation.
Use single typographic quotation marks ‘…’ inside double quotation marks. Preserve literal code syntax.
Do not add periods to acronyms or initialisms such as ZEC, DAO, URI, ZIP or FROST.
Respect all explicitly reviewed UI variants in their recorded interface contexts. Regional or grammatical variation is not a globally rejected rendering.
